APPROVE

The extracted helpers preserve the original control flow and state mutations (`broken`/`heldWhy`/`requeued` map to `ship.Unjudged`/`ship.Requeued`), and my count puts `RunTurnAsync` at about 14 (nearly all ternaries and ifs), under the 15 threshold. This rests on reading the diff alone: I couldn't build it, and the type names `OwedWrite`, `Dropped` and `ShipResult` are unverified.
